users.description: One row per person who can sign in.

sessions.description: Active sign-ins. The token is the value of the session cookie.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

boards.description: One board per user for the MVP, enforced by UNIQUE on user_id.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

board_columns.description: The fixed columns of a board. Titles can change; the set and order cannot.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

cards.description: Cards on a board. position orders the cards within a column.
foreign_keys: (board_id, column_id) REFERENCES board_columns(board_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
